interpretation.findings: Observed block arithmetic shares quantify where covered work occurs; null blocks were not executed. Cross-model timing uses different resolutions/outputs and cannot rank water quality; human/assistant visual review and hypothesis conclusions pending.
hypotheses: Image encoder dominates SAM static arithmetic; memory modules remain present.
Deep global-attention DINO features can have nonuniform distant sensitivity.
Latency is not determined by counted FLOPs alone.

No water quality metric, learned projection, probe, decoder training or automatic flow. Gradients are local channel-0 sensitivity. Partial FLOPs, warm allocator, isolated replay not additive.
